newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: HOCKEY-SPAIN FINISH TOP OF WORLD CUP QUALIFIERS.
newsitem.headline: HOCKEY-SPAIN FINISH TOP OF WORLD CUP QUALIFIERS.

text.p: A goal in extra time by Pablo Amat gave Olympic silver medallists Spain a 3-2 victory over South Korea on Saturday and top spot in the hockey World Cup qualifiers.
The Spanish, unbeaten in the qualifiers, and runners-up South Korea will be joined at the World Cup in Utrecht next year by New Zealand, Poland, Canada and Malaysia.

New Zealand won the third-place playoff against Poland 3-0, helped by two goals from John Radovonich whose three goals in the final seven minutes against Belgium earlier in the qualifiers had allowed his side to snatch a 3-2 victory.
Hosts Malaysia finished sixth to clinch their first World Cup place in 16 years.
But there was disappointment for Argentina who have played at every finals since the first World Cup in Barcelona in 1971. They finished only seventh to miss out on qualifying.
